business_problem: TeleSpecialists outgrew an under-configured CRM and no-automation marketing stack just as hospital, physician, and payer relationships made credentialing, onboarding, and growth increasingly exponential to manage.
solution_summary: TeleSpecialists rebuilt core operating workflows on Salesforce after outgrowing Zoho and ad hoc marketing tools. The company now runs the full physician lifecycle - lead, interview, contract, credentialing, hospital privilege, capacity planning, and IT onboarding - in one Salesforce system of record instead of handing work between disconnected teams. Agentforce reads onboarding requirements, scrubs documents, and summarizes what is stuck so staff no longer spend hours each day reviewing files manually; the same platform also powers an SDR agent that qualifies and books meetings with prospective hospital partners. Slackbot sits on top of hospital and physician data so teams can query opportunities and retrieve materials instantly, while Marketing Cloud provides segmented campaigns, lead scoring, and role-based personalization. MuleSoft underpins the next phase of a telemedicine billing stack by linking revenue workflows with hospital connectivity.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Acts as the system of record for TeleSpecialists' physician and hospital workflows.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Summarizes onboarding work, automates document review, and supports SDR qualification.

solution_components.name: Slackbot
solution_components.role: Lets teams query opportunities and find current sales materials directly in Slack.

solution_components.name: Marketing Cloud
solution_components.role: Runs segmented campaigns, lead scoring, and role-based outreach journeys.

solution_components.name: MuleSoft
solution_components.role: Supports integration between billing workflows and external hospital systems.

data_flow: Physician, hospital, recruiting, and onboarding data flows into Salesforce as a shared operational record. Agentforce summarizes credentialing requirements, Slackbot exposes opportunity and enablement context, Marketing Cloud uses engagement data for role-based campaigns, and MuleSoft carries billing data toward connected hospital systems.
business_outcome: TeleSpecialists doubled credentialing throughput, reduced review and turnaround times, improved sales and marketing visibility, and created a path to scale hospital growth without adding large back-office teams.
